name: Maren Vasse
role: Tuning-warden of the Harmonic Heights Lower Terrace — keeps the Warden Council's bulletin board, and decides what reaches the Council and when
appearance: A woman of about fifty with the Warden sash and deep acoustic calluses on both index fingers, standing watch by a bulletin board long enough for her tea to go cold.
voiceHints: Level and cataloguing, never alarmed. Pauses for calculation, not reluctance. Asks what goes to the Council before she decides how to log it.
wants: To know what the Warden Council should hear, and when, before she writes it down.
fears: The upper chamber moving on something before the Warden Council knows why.
knowledge: Every notice on the Lower Terrace bulletin board and who filed it
How to read relay traffic: three copies on one night with no stagger and a heavier seal is Council-internal
That Farren on the Second Terrace still consults for the Warden Council when nobody else can solve something

reactsToReputation.any: logs what you tell her, and asks what else she should know
reactsToReputation.reliable: backs you, on the condition that the Council can reach you

questSeeds: The Warden Council logged a missing apprentice as unsanctioned solo practice and gave it low priority
Priority Council packets are moving overnight and nobody has told the Lower Terrace why
gear: a tuning fork of dark crystal
title: Tuning-Warden of the Lower Terrace
_registryName: Maren — the save's registry calls her by her given name alone; four characters on this device have met a Maren. The record now carries a family name and a title so she is never only 'Maren' again.
_domainsWhy: what is so, logged in order, kept calm
